posts.body: I read that somewhere too to bring that bottle... the thing is: is it really necessary?? can you just wash with your hand with the cleaning liquids/ like daily cleaning procedure..
posts.body_with_quotes: I read that somewhere too to bring that bottle... the thing is: is it really necessary?? can you just wash with your hand with the cleaning liquids/ like daily cleaning procedure..

posts.body: You don't "need" it but it is very convenient especially when everything (body, shoulders, pelvic bone, wound) hurts and you are using public toilets.... It helps you to clean your wound very easily after each bathroom use... And really you just need to rinse with water... And will be very tricky to get water from tap to wash your wound with your pants down over the toilet without getting dirty or making a mess
